jobs.prompt: Fix a bug in tools/split-park-supersede.mjs (supersededSplitParks). When it finds the newest ingest run per stage, it counts EVERY split-park blocker event, including resolution events ({kind:'blocker', id, resolved:true, text}). A resolution copies the original blocker text, so it carries the OLD '--ingest <RUN>' with a NEWER ts. After 'swarm resolve --superseded-splits' appends those resolutions, a second run sees the old run as newest and wrongly resolves the blockers raised by the real newest ingest. Fix: only raise events (events where resolved is not true) decide the newest run per stage; resolution events must never change it. Keep everything else the same. Add tests to tests/split-park-supersede.test.mjs: (1) pure: after appending resolution events for the superseded ids (newer ts, old run text), supersededSplitParks returns no superseded items and keeps the newest-run blockers; (2) command: run 'resolve --superseded-splits' twice on the same temp journal; the second run resolves 0 and the newest-run blockers are still open in swarm inbox; (3) pure: a manual 'resolve ID' style resolution event of a newest-run blocker does not make older-run blockers count as current. tests/split-module.test.mjs only matches the file name prefix split-; it does not test this module.
